nodes.description: Create wallet via REST API with correct initial balance

Wallet top-up increases balance via wallet transactions. Self-contained: creates dedicated customer+wallet so it never depends on a wallet that earlier WALLET_TERMINATE/etc. nodes may have terminated in the shared context.

inputs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM wallet_transactions wt JOIN wallets w ON wt.wallet_id = w.id JOIN customers c ON w.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.external_id = 'wallet_topup_cust_001_5140'

scoring._round19_note: round-19 fix: topo-sort placed WALLET_TERMINATE (alphabetically) before WALLET_TOPUP under the same WALLET_CREATE prereq → WALLET_TERMINATE created+DELETEd a wallet (Lago DELETE = soft terminate, status='terminated'), and its UUID overwrote last_wallet_lago_id in the shared context. WALLET_TOPUP then POSTed wallet_transactions for the terminated wallet → baseline 422 'wallet_not_found' (terminated wallets are filtered by current_organization.wallets scope). Fix: WALLET_TOPUP now self-contains its own customer+wallet creation (wallet_topup_cust_001_5140 / Topup Wallet) so {{last_wallet_lago_id}} resolves to a fresh active wallet right before the transaction POST. Same exact assertion semantics — only the test fixture isolation changed.

nodes.description: Destroying a custom role soft-deletes it (sets deleted_at). Looks up the role UUID from DB before mutation so the test does not depend on cross-node placeholder substitution.

inputs.sql: SELECT id::text AS id FROM roles WHERE code = 'eval_viewer_001_5140' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

body.query: mutation { destroyRole(input: { id: "{{role_uuid}}" }) { id } }

inputs.sql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM roles WHERE code = 'eval_viewer_001_5140' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_deleted

scoring._round19_note: round-19 fix (two issues): (1) original chain used cross-node placeholder '{{RBAC_CUSTOM_ROLE_CREATE.data.createRole.id}}' which mnmtxiwb's _resolve only supports for context dict keys, NOT dotted paths into prior node responses → the literal string was sent as the GraphQL id, mutation silently failed, role kept deleted_at=NULL. (2) Original verification SQL 'SELECT deleted_at IS NOT NULL FROM roles WHERE code=...' could pick the wrong row when partial unique index allowed duplicate codes across soft-delete generations. Fix: prepend P08 with save_id='role_uuid' (looks up the live role from DB by code) and P04 destroyRole now references {{role_uuid}} which _resolve handles. Verification P08 uses EXISTS(...AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL) so it tolerates row-order non-determinism. Baseline behavior unchanged: Roles::DestroyService calls role.discard! which sets deleted_at.
